caption:
Today’s affirmations, written by Cella. She is very proud of them.
Comment CLAIMED and they are yours.
Link in bio.
by NMR

alt.1: Video with our own music, 6 seconds. Lime green field with pop stars in the corners. The title in 90s word-art, pink gradient letters with a white and black outline and a hard shadow, spins once. Cella, a small dark figure with a flat red crown, rises in from the bottom and her crown sparkles. Title: Today's affirmations by Cella. Below: Comment CLAIMED to take them.
alt.2: Hot magenta field, pop stars in the corners, the affirmation in huge yellow word-art. Cella below with her eyes shut and her crown on, proud, next to a sticker that says “© CELLA”. Affirmation number 1: “I answer texts in under three days.”
alt.3: Orange field, pop stars in the corners, the affirmation in huge blue word-art. Cella below with her eyes shut and her crown on, proud, next to a sticker that says “© CELLA”. Affirmation number 2: “I send the message without rereading it 40 times.”
alt.4: Hot magenta field, pop stars in the corners, the affirmation in huge yellow word-art. Cella below with her eyes shut and her crown on, proud, next to a sticker that says “© CELLA”. Affirmation number 3: “The universe saves me a parking spot. Obviously.”
alt.5: Lime green field, the affirmation in huge pink word-art, a big red rubber stamp that says CLAIMED, and Cella facing front with her crown. Affirmation number 4: “I am already this gorgeous. You may copy.” A red stamp reads CLAIMED. Comment CLAIMED to take it.
